audit_scope: Read-only review of original portable source and sealed data, exported results, and current GitHub source; numerical reconstruction of input preprocessing and scores. No estimator or calibrator was trained. Counterfactual input scaling illustrates numerical conditioning only, not predictive performance.

export_excluded.fits/: per-fit predictions, losses, coefficients and model packages
export_excluded._parallel/: parallel scheduler queue and worker logs

provenance.execution_code_gap: HOW_TO_APPLY documents an in-memory model hash shim and external parallel execution; their source and serial-parallel validation records are not included.

findings.finding: Tiny positive train IQRs amplify bounded current-state probabilities and lags to millions. This is a shared input adaptation defect.

Official SAGA step formula, applied to reconstructed training X, yields 8.779e-15 initially for All-A. This establishes a concrete numerical obstruction; it does not measure optimality errors for every archived fit.
Classification is three-class, initial train 251 weeks; full development scoring 150 weeks and test scoring 194 weeks. Training rows expand to 600 by 2026-11.
Reported score arithmetic and probability/class ordering reproduce at floating precision; all exported file hashes match.
Test CSI300 macro accuracy rises by 0.1185567, not falls. Tiny probability ranking changes explain why accuracy can move substantially while log loss scarcely changes.
118/256 regression coarse group-candidates are invalid. There are 1240 failed regression monthly fit records. Seven of eight regression winners choose alpha=10.
The completed suite is core; macro-group full-suite experiments are not in this run.
Exact nonzero coefficient counts, saved-model training first-order conditions, and the external runtime shim/parallel equivalence require small additional artifacts.

input_mechanism_check.scope: Preprocessing and step-size algebra only; no prediction model or calibrator was fitted; proposed scaling is a diagnostic illustration, not a performance experiment.

recommendation: Fix shared input scaling, numerical convergence acceptance, and execution provenance first; then perform a new development selection, new lock, and test evaluation for all Elastic Net core M/M+Z groups. Defer formal RBF-SVM execution until shared preprocessing is repaired. Preserve old run; do not tune for positive macro gains. Corrected reuse of already-viewed test data must be disclosed.
